scripts.verify:dist: npm run export:web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')){console.error('dist build FAILED: dist/index.html missing'); process.exit(1)} console.log('dist build OK: dist/index.html found')"
scripts.vercel:preview: npm run export:web && npx -y vercel@latest deploy --cwd .
scripts.vercel:prod: npm run export:web && npx -y vercel@latest deploy --cwd . --prod
scripts.build:ios:check: npx -y eas-cli whoami && npx -y eas-cli build -p ios --profile production
